title: Creamy Biryani Fried Rice
description: A Chinese twist on the Indian classic, this creamy fried rice dish is a perfect blend of cultures. With the addition of unique biryani spices and creamy foie gras, this dish is sure to impress.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add cooked biryani rice to the wok or skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add crumbled foie gras, soy sauce, and unique spices to the rice mixture.
Stir-fry everything together for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the foie gras is fully incorporated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the rice mixture to a serving platter.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
Optional: serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple green salad.
